title: CTE joined with customers
prompt: Using a CTE named totals that computes total amount per customer_id (as total), join it with the customers table to return each customer's name and their total. Customers with no orders can be excluded.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE cust12 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO cust12 VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Carol'); CREATE TABLE ord12 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount REAL); INSERT INTO ord12 VALUES (1,1,50.0),(2,1,30.0),(3,2,200.0),(4,3,10.0);
reference_sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM ord12 GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT cust12.name, totals.total FROM cust12 JOIN totals ON cust12.id = totals.customer_id;
